examples.scenario: 日常商務 (圖像記憶錨點)
examples.en: During the annual shareholders meeting, executive directors highlighted the fundamental importance of excitement.
examples.zh: 在年度股東大會上，執行董事們強調了【興奮】的根本重要性。

examples.en: The plant supervisor implemented strict operational guidelines to ensure consistent quality in excitement.

examples.en: Strategic investment in excitement has positioned our enterprise as a frontrunner in global market competition.
examples.zh: 在【興奮】上的策略性投資，使我司在全球市場競爭中躍居領先地位。

quizzes.stem: The regional director emphasized that corporate _____ remains our highest priority for the upcoming fiscal year.
quizzes.stemTranslation: 區域總監強調，企業【興奮】依然是我們下一會計年度的首要重點。

quizzes.examTrapTip: 注意名詞單複數與可數/不可數之文法特徵。

optionAnalyses.reason: 【正解】詞義「興奮」與文法形態完全切合題幹之商務語境。
【干擾】此選項與題幹前後文意及商務搭配不符，予以排除。
